row.evidence: Cascade's help centre documents only SAML 2.0 SSO (set up through the Cascade team, available on Essentials and Enterprise+); neither help centre, the pricing page nor the API token docs mention SCIM or automated provisioning.
row.notes: Status moved from unknown to none by absence (confidence medium): no SCIM, provisioning or directory-sync mention on the pricing page or in either help centre (support.cascade.app and the legacy help.cascade.app 'CG Knowledge Base', 439 sitemap pages; 52 unrelated support.cascade.app pages were rate-limited and not re-read). Plans: Plan (free, 2 users), Essentials and Enterprise (both Contact Us); June's 'free up to 4 users' is now 2 users. SSO is SAML 2.0, configured by Cascade support; the help centre says Essentials or Enterprise+, while the pricing table shows 'SSO & Data Sovereignty' only on Enterprise (see conflicts). Entra is a non-gallery app. Users can be bulk-imported from a template; the legacy KB documents an Enterprise-only API with a 'Roles & Users' token scope and a bulk user importer (PowerShell) for HR/payroll sync, but no public endpoint reference.
